title: demand_era is validated but never read — invariant (b) checks a different demand row than the runtime serves
evidence: catalog.odin:1232 `drow := &cat.demand.eras[de-1]` (de = demand_era); flow.odin:734 `plan := scripted_plan_demand(cat, state.era, tick)`; demand.odin:52 `de := &cat.demand.eras[era-1]`. `rg demand_era core/` shows reads only in the load block + tests — no runtime consumer.
detail: Guard requires the invariants be 'non-circular (they can't silently pass with a wrong table)'. With demand_era != era, invariant (b) validates the demand_era row while the director serves demand.eras[era-1] — an unchecked row could spawn a class the era's roster hasn't unlocked, silently passing load.
recommended_fix: Point invariant (b) at the actually-served row cat.demand.eras[era-1], or enforce demand_era == era at load, or make the director resolve demand via era_row(cat, era).demand_era.

title: PR body omits the required ODN-16 citation (Acceptance #4)
evidence: Briefing Acceptance 4: 'PR body: the eras.json schema, the FSM advance surface 6.2 composes on, citations (ODN-16, ODN-5, E14, stories-v2 6.1)'. PR body line 7: 'integer-only + fail-fast validated `[ODN-5]`, and no mid-crisis demand spawn `[E14]`'; line 118: '- **GWT trace (stories-v2 6.1)**'. `grep -c "ODN-16" _bmad-output/pr-bodies/6.1.md` -> 0.
detail: The brief's Acceptance #4 names four mandatory citations; ODN-16 (Era FSM S6 — the story's own system tag, cited in the story card as `[ODN-16]`) appears nowhere in the shipped PR body.
recommended_fix: Add an ODN-16 citation where the PR body introduces the S6 Era FSM (e.g. 'the S6 Era FSM (core/era.odin, new) [ODN-16]').

title: PR body says '20 new fail-fast rows'; the test adds 22 rejection assertions
evidence: PR body: '- **`core/catalog_test.odin`** (20 new fail-fast rows): malformed eras docs, unknown refs, demand_era out-of-range/decimal/missing, both invariant directions (premature listing + missing unlock/roster), and the demand-⊄-roster rejection — plus the `check_ok` positive assertions.' The eras_rows literal contains 21 entries ('bad json' .. 'era-2 unlock missing small_biz') plus the separate invariant-(b) check_reject call = 22.
detail: Prose/count mismatch only — the actual coverage exceeds the claim (21 table rows + 1 builder row = 22 vs '20'). No acceptance criterion governs the exact count; flagging for PR-body accuracy.
recommended_fix: Update the PR body to '22 new fail-fast rows' (or the intended count) to match core/catalog_test.odin.
